Ahead, the dark-tiled roof of a traditional wooden pavilion gradually emerges from the bamboo shadows as she proceeds deeper into the grove. Her wide sheer sleeves sway gently with each step, the pink blossom embroidery catching intermittent flecks of amber light. The path curves slightly to the right, and the pavilion comes into fuller view — its open sides revealing a seated figure within. Ambient bamboo-rustle and distant birdsong fill the soundscape. No dialogue.

She breaks into a light joyful run toward the pavilion, her red-coral wide sleeves billowing behind her, bare feet padding quickly across the stone path. The camera holds a static position as she runs from mid-ground toward the pavilion in the background, her figure shrinking slightly with distance. The guqin's resonant plucked notes become audible as she approaches. No dialogue.

[Shot 3] At 00:10.500, the camera cuts hard to a close-up framed at chest-height of <Subject 1>, whose face, red-coral hanfu upper bodice, and floral embroidery from <Picture 1> fill most of the frame. She has reached the pavilion perimeter and stopped; now she rests her chin on the palm of her right hand, elbow propped on an invisible surface at frame-bottom, her head tilted slightly with a soft lovestruck smile. Her eyes, bright with quiet adoration, gaze off-camera toward where <Subject 2> sits playing — only the blue-clad shoulder and the guqin's curved edge are partially visible at the far right edge of frame, confirming <Subject 2>'s presence from <Picture 2>. The <Subject 4> teal-amber color grade, desaturated midtones, low-key chiaroscuro, and gentle vignette remain fully intact through the hard cut. Soft guqin notes continue in the background. Her expression is one of pure unguarded tenderness — lips parted slightly in a dreamy half-smile, cheeks faintly warm. She does not speak. The shot holds steady until the end.
